### The Mimir browser extension

- **Agents can use a browser of their own.** A new Mimir extension for Chrome and Edge lets your agents open tabs in a Mimir window and read, click, type, press keys, scroll and take pictures there, much like Claude in Chrome. It works on every engine, DeepSeek and Mimir credits included: agents read a page as a numbered list of its buttons, links and fields, so a model that cannot see pictures can still use it. Claude and Codex also get the screenshots.
- **It stays your browser.** Agents can only touch the tabs they opened, or a tab you share from the extension's button. Every such tab has a gold frame with a Stop button, the toolbar button has Stop too, and Stop holds until you press Resume. Agents never type into password or payment fields, never open browser pages or the extension store, and only use the browser while "Auto-approve web & network" is on.
- **Set it up in Settings → Browser.** Turn on the browser link (Mimir asks in its own dialog), load the extension folder it shows in Chrome or Edge, then type the six-digit code into the extension once. It talks only to Mimir on this computer.
- **Ask Mimir about any page.** The extension's button (or right-click → Ask Mimir about this) sends the page and your question to a new Mimir chat. It also shows the Lounge's song with play and skip buttons, and your credits balance.

### Pairing works with the App Store phone app

- **The pairing QR opens either phone app.** Settings → Phone's QR used to be a link only Mimir Dev understood, so the camera could not hand it to Mimir Mobile from the App Store. It now opens a page on wellmimir.com that offers both apps and shows the address and code to type by hand. The address and code stay in the part of the link the browser never sends to the site.
